rationale: The original entry rationale relied on higher lows and 9-EMA support around $16.34, but price has since broken below the entry and is now sitting at $16.36 with the most recent candles showing a clear downward sequence (closes of $16.42 and $16.39) and zero favorable excursion since entry. The 9-EMA has caught up to current price ($16.36), eliminating the upside cushion, and with the invalidation at $16.28 only $0.08 away versus a take-profit at $16.72 that is $0.36 away, the asymmetry looks poor given the bearish momentum. Closing now preserves capital and avoids a likely stop-out at a worse price.
